ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (<5%) to low-intensity pixels (>95%) across the predominantly dark-grey to black visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) contiguous region covering >90% of visible surface. Discrete high-intensity (white) clusters localized on the distal margin of the right lobe and the distal trailing edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center. Interior angle approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the right lobe trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of approx 5-10 units. Left lobe edge appears less irregular due to orientation but exhibits visible jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows a convex outer curve. Left lobe shows a linear to slightly convex sweep, partially occluded by water splash at the base.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white clusters located at the distal-most tip of the right lobe and multiple smaller clusters along the distal edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of calcified bio-fouling concentrated on the right lobe distal tip and left lobe distal edge.
